baseline.label: Wiki baseline 0.0 — before source synchronization
baseline.rollbackNote: The branch points to the original pre-sync wiki. Restore selected files or reset from this commit only after reviewing later changes.

policy.confirmation: A valid numeric ID in the relevant Jobmania Database data sheet is required before a new gameplay asset can be imported. Unnumbered rows are pending/unconfirmed, not missing implemented content.
policy.localization: Localization entries require a matching confirmed gameplay asset. Preserve exact stable canonical keys; inspect whitespace/key differences before syncing.
policy.status: When explicit development status exists, do not import incomplete, stopped, untested, or otherwise unconfirmed entries automatically.
policy.changes: Never generate IDs, delete unmatched existing records, or overwrite gameplay values on the basis of a name-only diff.
policy.versioning: 0.0 identifies the wiki baseline only. Future synced wiki versions follow the game Database Ver Log version number.
policy.audit: Do not advance lastAuditedGameVersion or lastSyncedGameVersion until the relevant version's confirmed items have been checked. New records, field changes, and related translations must be verified separately.

auditHistory.note: Recorded pre-sync revision and schema. No gameplay entries, localization data, or mechanics changed; confirmed numeric-ID audit is not yet complete.

Added 22 jobs, 7 characters, 69 abilities and 26 passive skills, their corresponding new localization records, structured ability/passive skill units, and extended AP cost alignment. Existing core records/stats/effect differences are not yet fully audited; wiki checkpoint remains 0.0. Corrected version log to include all 69 new abilities.

Confirmed changes: 5 job field values, 4 character stat values, 2 ability icons, 20 ability skill-unit definitions and 65 passive skill-unit definitions. Existing ability-cost mismatches and prior localization differences remain for separate review.

Added 2 numbered relics and localization, changed Quolot's Eye passive, revised confirmed relic-passive IDs 150-153, added 24 recipes tied to numbered materials (22 corresponding material combine-list links), and documented 2.48.0 turn-start behavior. Preserved unnumbered Combo relic-passives and pre-existing conflicting craft recipes. No automatic release checkpoint advance.
